rationale: Adds 21 columns to the persisted emails table and widens the category constraint, changing what data is stored and retrieved; alongside new API routes and frontend rewiring to use the enriched schema.

signals.blast_radius: Schema migration, expanded triage prompt, 11 new API routes, and frontend rewiring across inbox, board sheet, review queue, and overview
